160 Electric Detonators Found Near Army Camp in Secunderabad

Police in Secunderabad discovered 160 electric detonators in a light green plastic bucket near an Army camp. The detonators were found near the wall behind the firing range, close to a construction venture beside the golf course. Authorities stated the detonators were allegedly abandoned during the venture's construction and are unrelated to any arms theft case. The discovery was made in Bollaram.
